blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected all five current V44 views and six pose renders. Angular, irregular clumped folds remain prominent across the overskirt and the split-front hem remains asymmetric and sharply pointed; the neutral skirt does not read as continuous, controlled fabric drape.

Direct inspection of current V44 sit and crouch views still shows large rounded shorts-like thigh shells protruding above and ahead of the overskirt. The front panels remain as separated narrow flaps below and beside the shells, leaving anterior thighs visibly uncovered. The V44 explicit shorts thigh-follow weight hypothesis did not correct coverage or volume.
The current V44 full-body back view still shows only a small low-contrast waist detail; its intended adjustment-tab function cannot be read at this scale and no close-up evidence exists.

The current source-bound chart remains unchanged and proves authored UV coordinates for only three objects. Eighteen active UVMap layers remain provenance-unverified and omitted; four objects report UV not created. No replacement UVs were generated. Complete garment UV acceptance remains blocked.

The V44 skin export reports weightedPrototypeSha256 b337270449abf64e03403ad07f203ae68d5117c2b0670b01a8da157778d2fa81, identical to the prior reviewed source hash b337270449abf64e03403ad07f203ae68d5117c2b0670b01a8da157778d2fa81. The declared V44 shorts-specific weight profile therefore did not produce a distinct weighted source artifact; the recipe change is not evidenced in the exported prototype.
